scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,user_entry,admin,sched,comp" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w apps/user_entry" "npm run dev -w apps/administration" "npm run dev -w apps/scheduling" "npm run dev -w apps/competencies"
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:infra && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/user_entry && npm run build -w apps/administration && npm run build -w apps/scheduling && npm run build -w apps/competencies
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/user_entry && npm run typecheck -w apps/administration && npm run typecheck -w apps/scheduling && npm run typecheck -w apps/competencies
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test:unit
